054        public static class DwellerEncounterScript implements EveryFrameScript {
055                protected float elapsed = 0f;
056                protected String trigger;
057                protected boolean done = false;
058                protected float triggerDelay;
059                protected SectorEntityToken light;
060                protected CampaignFleetAPI fleet;
061                public DwellerEncounterScript(String trigger, CampaignFleetAPI fleet, SectorEntityToken light) {
062                        this.trigger = trigger;
063                        this.fleet = fleet;
064                        this.light = light;
065                        triggerDelay = 1f + (float) Math.random() * 1f;
066                        
067                }
068                public boolean isDone() {
069                        return done;
070                }
071                public boolean runWhilePaused() {
072                        return false;
073                }
074                public void advance(float amount) {
075                        if (done) return;
076                        
077                        if (Global.getSector().isPaused() || Global.getSector().getCampaignUI().isShowingDialog()) {
078                                return;
079                        }
080                        
081                        elapsed += amount;
082                        
083                        if (fleet == null || elapsed > 3f || !light.isAlive() || light.hasTag(Tags.FADING_OUT_AND_EXPIRING) ||
084                                        fleet.getContainingLocation() != light.getContainingLocation()) {
085                                done = true;
086                                return;
087                        }
088                        
089                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet, light) - fleet.getRadius() - light.getRadius();
090                        if (dist > DWELLER_TRIGGER_RANGE) {
091                                done = true;
092                                return;
093                        }
094                        
095                        
096                        if (elapsed > triggerDelay) {
097                                if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
098                                        Misc.showRuleDialog(light, trigger);
099                                } else {
100                                        fleet.despawn(FleetDespawnReason.DESTROYED_BY_BATTLE, light);
101                                        if (light.getCustomPlugin() instanceof AbyssalLightEntityPlugin) {
102                                                AbyssalLightEntityPlugin plugin = (AbyssalLightEntityPlugin) light.getCustomPlugin();
103                                                plugin.despawn(DespawnType.FADE_OUT);
104                                        }
105                                }
106                                done = true;
107                                return;
108                        }
109                }
110        }
111        public static class AbyssalLightSoundStopper implements EveryFrameScript {
112                protected transient SoundAPI sound = null;
113                protected float elapsed = 0f;
114                public AbyssalLightSoundStopper(SoundAPI sound) {
115                        this.sound = sound;
116                }
117                public boolean isDone() {
118                        return sound == null;
119                }
120                public boolean runWhilePaused() {
121                        return true;
122                }
123                public void advance(float amount) {
124                        elapsed += amount;
125                        if (sound == null) return;
126                        if (!sound.isPlaying() && elapsed > 1f) {
127                                sound = null;
128                                return;
129                        }
130                        
131                        if (Global.getSector().isPaused() && sound != null) {
132                                sound.stop();
133                                sound = null;
134                        }
135                }
136        }
137        public static class AbyssalLightParams {
138                public Color color = new Color(200,200,255,255);
139                public float frequencyMultMin = 0.5f;
140                public float frequencyMultMax = 1.5f;
141                public float frequencyChangeMult = 1f;
142                public float size;
143                public float detectedRange;
144                public float bonusMult;
145                public float durationDays;
146                public Boolean permanent = null;
147                public int pointsOverride = 0;
148                
149                public AbyssalLightParams() {
150                        this(MIN_SIZE, MAX_SIZE);
151                }
152                public AbyssalLightParams(float minSize, float maxSize) {
153                        frequencyMultMin = 0.5f;
154                        frequencyMultMax = 1.5f;
155                        
156                        float sizeRange = maxSize - minSize;
157                        float avgSize = MIN_SIZE + (MAX_SIZE - MIN_SIZE) * 0.5f;
158                        
159                        
160                        size = minSize + (float) Math.random() * sizeRange;
161                        detectedRange = (size * 3f) / HyperspaceTerrainPlugin.ABYSS_SENSOR_RANGE_MULT;
162                        
163                        bonusMult = size / avgSize;
164                        
165                        durationDays = MIN_DURATION + (MAX_DURATION - MIN_DURATION) * (float) Math.random();
166                }
167                
168                public int getTopographyPoints() {
169                        if (pointsOverride > 0) return pointsOverride;
170                        
171                        return Math.round(HTPoints.ABYSSAL_LIGHT_MIN +
172                                        (HTPoints.ABYSSAL_LIGHT_AVG - HTPoints.ABYSSAL_LIGHT_MIN) * bonusMult);
173                }
174        }

192        public void init(SectorEntityToken entity, Object pluginParams) {
193                super.init(entity, pluginParams);
194                params = (AbyssalLightParams) pluginParams;
195                
196                float radiusMult = params.bonusMult;
197                if (radiusMult > 1f) {
198                        radiusMult = 1f + (radiusMult - 1f) * 0.33f;
199                } else if (radiusMult < 1f) {
200                        radiusMult = 1f - (1f - radiusMult) * 0.33f; 
201                }
202                ((CustomCampaignEntityAPI) entity).setRadius(entity.getRadius() * radiusMult);
203                entity.setSensorProfile(1f);
204                entity.setDiscoverable(false);
205                //entity.setDiscoveryXP(spec.getDiscoveryXP());
206                
207                entity.getDetectedRangeMod().modifyFlat("gen", params.detectedRange);
208                entity.setExtendedDetectedAtRange(2000f);
209                entity.setDetectionRangeDetailsOverrideMult(0.5f);
210                entity.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(MemFlags.EXTRA_SENSOR_INDICATORS, 3);
211                
212                updateFrequency(0f);
213                updateSoundDelayAndPlaySound(0f);
214                readResolve();
215        }

217        public boolean isDespawning() {
218                return despawnType != null || entity.hasTag(Tags.FADING_OUT_AND_EXPIRING);

221        public void despawn(DespawnType type) {
222                if (isDespawning()) return;
223                
224                float dur = 1f;
225                if (type == DespawnType.EXPAND) dur = 2f;
226                Misc.fadeAndExpire(entity, dur);
227                despawnType = type;
228                
229                if (type == DespawnType.EXPAND && entity.isInCurrentLocation()) {
230                        VisibilityLevel level = entity.getVisibilityLevelToPlayerFleet();
231                        if (level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_DETAILS || level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_AND_FACTION_DETAILS) {
232                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound("abyssal_light_expand_despawn_windup", 1f, 1f, entity.getLocation(), Misc.ZERO);
233                        }
234                }
235        }

239                if (untilSoundPlayed <= 0f) {
240                        //untilSoundPlayed = 0.5f + (float) Math.random() * 20f;
241                        untilSoundPlayed = 5f + (float) Math.random() * 30f;
242                
243                        // don't play sound when called from the constructor with amount == 0f
244                        if (amount > 0 && entity.isInCurrentLocation()) {
245                                VisibilityLevel level = entity.getVisibilityLevelToPlayerFleet();
246                                if (level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_DETAILS || level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_AND_FACTION_DETAILS) {

264// too random

267//                                              if (fleet != null && abilityResponseFlickerTimeout <= 0f) {

280        public void updateFrequency(float amount) {
281                untilFrequencyChange -= amount * params.frequencyChangeMult;
282                if (untilFrequencyChange <= 0f) {
283                        untilFrequencyChange = 1f + (float) Math.random() * 3f;
284                        
285                        frequencyMult = params.frequencyMultMin * 
286                                        (float) Math.random() * (params.frequencyMultMax - params.frequencyMultMin);
287                }
288        }

303        public void advance(float amount) {
304                if (isDespawning()) {
305                        if (!playedDespawnSound && 
306                                        (getDespawnProgress() > DESPAWN_POOF_THRESHOLD || despawnType == DespawnType.FADE_OUT)) {
307                                playedDespawnSound = true;
308                                if (entity.isInCurrentLocation()) {
309                                        VisibilityLevel level = entity.getVisibilityLevelToPlayerFleet();
310                                        if (level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_DETAILS || level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_AND_FACTION_DETAILS) {
311                                                String soundId = "abyssal_light_despawn_disrupted";
312                                                if (despawnType == DespawnType.FADE_OUT) {
313                                                        soundId = "abyssal_light_despawn_expired";
314                                                }
315                                                Global.getSoundPlayer().playSound(soundId, 1f, 1f, entity.getLocation(), Misc.ZERO);
316                                        }
317                                }
318                        }
319                        
320                        return;
321                }
322                
323                //boolean dweller = isDespawning(); 
324                
325                if (params.permanent == null) {
326                        float days = Misc.getDays(amount);
327                        params.durationDays -= days;
328                        if (params.durationDays <= 0f || Misc.getAbyssalDepth(entity) < 1f) {
329                                despawn(DespawnType.FADE_OUT);
330                                return;
331                        }
332                }
333                
334                updateFrequency(amount);
335                updateSoundDelayAndPlaySound(amount);
336                
337                phase += amount * GLOW_FREQUENCY * frequencyMult;
338                while (phase > 1) phase --;
339                
340                if (flickerDur > 0) {
341                        flickerDur -= amount;
342                        if (flickerDur < 0) flickerDur = 0;
343                }
344                if (abilityResponseFlickerTimeout > 0) {
345                        abilityResponseFlickerTimeout -= amount;
346                        if (abilityResponseFlickerTimeout < 0) abilityResponseFlickerTimeout = 0;
347                        //System.out.println("Timeout: " + abilityResponseFlickerTimeout);
348                }
349                
350                flicker.advance(amount * 10f);
351                fader.advance(amount);
352                
353                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.GLOBAL_INTERDICTION_PULSE_JUST_USED_IN_CURRENT_LOCATION)) {
354                        if (entity.getContainingLocation() != null) {
355                                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : entity.getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
356                                        float range = InterdictionPulseAbility.getRange(fleet);
357                                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), entity.getLocation());
358                                        if (dist > range) continue;
359                                        
360                                        
361                                        if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.JUST_DID_INTERDICTION_PULSE)) {
362                                                if (isDweller()) {
363                                                        if (abilityResponseFlickerTimeout <= 0f) {
364                                                                flickerDur = 0.5f + 0.5f * (float) Math.random();
365                                                                abilityResponseFlickerTimeout = 6f;
366                                                                if (dist < DWELLER_TRIGGER_RANGE + fleet.getRadius() + entity.getRadius()) {
367                                                                        Global.getSector().addScript(new DwellerEncounterScript("DwellerAttackAfterAbilityUse", fleet, entity));
368                                                                }                                               
369                                                        }
370                                                } else {
371                                                        AbyssalLightBonus bonus = AbyssalLightBonus.get(fleet);
372                                                        
373                                                        float brightness = getProximityBasedBrightnessFactor(fleet, entity.getLocation());
374                                                        bonus.addBurnBonus(params.bonusMult * brightness);
375                                                        
376                                                        if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
377                                                                bonus.addTopographyPoints(params.getTopographyPoints());
378                                                        }
379                                                        
380                                                        despawn(DespawnType.EXPAND);
381                                                }
382                                        }
383                                }
384                        }
385                        if (isDespawning()) return;
386                }
387                
388                if (Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.GLOBAL_SENSOR_BURST_JUST_USED_IN_CURRENT_LOCATION)) {
389                        if (entity.getContainingLocation() != null) {
390                                for (CampaignFleetAPI fleet : entity.getContainingLocation().getFleets()) {
391                                        float range = SENSOR_BURST_TRIGGER_RANGE + fleet.getRadius() + entity.getRadius();
392                                        float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), entity.getLocation());
393                                        if (dist > range) continue;
394                                        
395                                        
396                                        if (fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(MemFlags.JUST_DID_SENSOR_BURST)) {
397                                                if (isDweller()) {
398                                                        if (abilityResponseFlickerTimeout <= 0f) {
399                                                                flickerDur = 0.5f + 0.5f * (float) Math.random();
400                                                                abilityResponseFlickerTimeout = 6f;
401                                                                if (dist < DWELLER_TRIGGER_RANGE + fleet.getRadius() + entity.getRadius()) {
402                                                                        Global.getSector().addScript(new DwellerEncounterScript("DwellerAttackAfterAbilityUse", fleet, entity));
403                                                                }                                               
404                                                        }
405                                                } else {
406                                                        AbyssalLightBonus bonus = AbyssalLightBonus.get(fleet);
407                                                        
408                                                        float brightness = getProximityBasedBrightnessFactor(fleet, entity.getLocation());
409                                                        bonus.addSensorBonus(params.bonusMult * brightness);
410                                                        
411                                                        if (fleet.isPlayerFleet()) {
412                                                                bonus.addTopographyPoints(params.getTopographyPoints());
413                                                                
414                                                                // can cause overlapping gravity wells etc
415                                                                //EncounterManager.getInstance().getPointTimeout().clear();
416                                                                EncounterManager.getInstance().getCreatorTimeout().clear();
417                                                        }
418                                                        
419                                                        despawn(DespawnType.EXPAND);
420                                                }
421                                        }
422                                }
423                        }
424                        if (isDespawning()) return;
425                }
426        }

428        public float getFlickerBasedMult() {
429                if (flickerDur <= 0f) return 1f;
430                
431                float mult = 1f;
432                if (flickerDur < 1f) mult = flickerDur;
433                
434                if (isDweller()) {
435                        mult *= 0.75f;
436                } else {
437                        mult *= 0.25f;
438                }
439                
440                float f = 1f - flicker.getBrightness() * mult;
441                return f;
442        }
443        
444        public float getGlowAlpha() {
445                float glowAlpha = 0f;
446                if (phase < 0.5f) glowAlpha = phase * 2f;
447                if (phase >= 0.5f) glowAlpha = (1f - (phase - 0.5f) * 2f);
448                glowAlpha = 0.75f + glowAlpha * 0.25f;
449                
450                if (glowAlpha < 0) glowAlpha = 0;
451                if (glowAlpha > 1) glowAlpha = 1;
452                return glowAlpha;
453        }

461        public float getDespawnProgress() {
462                if (!isDespawning()) return 0f;

467        public void render(CampaignEngineLayers layer, ViewportAPI viewport) {
468                float alphaMult = viewport.getAlphaMult();
469                
470                if (!isDespawning() || despawnType == DespawnType.FADE_OUT) {
471                        alphaMult *= entity.getSensorFaderBrightness();
472                }
473                
474                if (alphaMult <= 0) return;
475                
476                float f = getDespawnProgress();
477                if (despawnType == DespawnType.FADE_OUT) {
478                        f = 0f;
479                }
480                
481                if (f > DESPAWN_POOF_THRESHOLD) {
482                        float fadeOut = (1f - f) / (1f - DESPAWN_POOF_THRESHOLD);
483                        alphaMult *= fadeOut;
484                }
485                
486                VisibilityLevel level = entity.getVisibilityLevelToPlayerFleet();
487                if (level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_DETAILS || level == VisibilityLevel.COMPOSITION_AND_FACTION_DETAILS) {
488                        fader.fadeIn();
489                } else {
490                        fader.fadeOut();
491                }
492                
493                alphaMult *= fader.getBrightness();
494                
495                float b = getPlayerProximityBasedBrightnessFactor(entity);
496                alphaMult *= b;
497                
498                
499//              if (Misc.getDistanceToPlayerLY(entity) > 0.1f) {
500//                      Misc.fadeAndExpire(entity);
501//                      return;
502//              }
503//              if (!Global.getSector().isPaused()) {
504//                      System.out.println("Alpha: " + alphaMult);
505//              }
506
507                CustomEntitySpecAPI spec = entity.getCustomEntitySpec();
508                if (spec == null) return;
509                
510                float w = spec.getSpriteWidth();
511                float h = spec.getSpriteHeight();
512                
513                Vector2f loc = entity.getLocation();
514                
515                float glowAlpha = getGlowAlpha();
516                
517                glow.setColor(params.color);
518                
519                w = params.size;
520                h = params.size;
521                
522                float scale = 0.25f + alphaMult * 0.75f;
523                if (f > DESPAWN_POOF_THRESHOLD) {
524                        scale *= 1.5f;
525                }
526                
527                float fringeScale = 1f;
528                //fringeScale = 1.5f;
529                
530                glow.setAdditiveBlend();
531                
532                if (layer == CampaignEngineLayers.TERRAIN_8) {
533                        //float flicker = getFlickerBasedMult();
534                        glow.setAlphaMult(alphaMult * glowAlpha * 0.5f);
535                        glow.setSize(w * scale * fringeScale, h * scale * fringeScale);
536                        
537                        glow.renderAtCenter(loc.x, loc.y);
538                }
539                
540                if (layer == CampaignEngineLayers.STATIONS) {
541                        if (f > 0f) {
542                                float extra = 1f + f * 1.33f;
543                                if (f > DESPAWN_POOF_THRESHOLD) extra = 0f;
544                                scale *= extra;
545                        }
546                        float flicker = getFlickerBasedMult();
547                        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
548                                if (i != 0) flicker = 1f;
549                                
550                                w *= 0.3f;
551                                h *= 0.3f;
552                                glow.setSize(w * scale, h * scale);
553                                glow.setAlphaMult(alphaMult * glowAlpha * 0.67f * flicker);
554                                glow.renderAtCenter(loc.x, loc.y);
555                        }
556                }
557        }

559        
560        public static float getPlayerProximityBasedBrightnessFactor(SectorEntityToken entity) {
561                return getPlayerProximityBasedBrightnessFactor(entity.getLocation());
562        }
563        public static float getPlayerProximityBasedBrightnessFactor(Vector2f loc) {
564                CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
565                if (player == null) {
566                        return PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MIN_BRIGHTNESS;
567                }
568                return getProximityBasedBrightnessFactor(player, loc);
569        }
570        
571        public static float getProximityBasedBrightnessFactor(CampaignFleetAPI from, Vector2f loc) {
572                
573                float dist = Misc.getDistance(from.getLocation(), loc) - from.getRadius();
574                
575                if (dist <= PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MAX_BRIGHTNESS_AT) {
576                        return 1f;
577                        //return Math.max(PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MIN_BRIGHTNESS, dist / PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MAX_BRIGHTNESS_AT);
578                }
579                dist -= PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MAX_BRIGHTNESS_AT;
580                
581                float f = 1f - dist / (PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MIN_BRIGHTNESS_AT - PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MAX_BRIGHTNESS_AT);
582                if (f < 0f) f = 0f;
583                
584                float b = PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MIN_BRIGHTNESS + f * (1f - PLAYER_PROXIMITY_MIN_BRIGHTNESS);
585                
586                return b;
587        }
